item.title: Introducing Nimbus 2.5, our most capable model
item.description: Today we are releasing Nimbus 2.5, a new model with a 1M-token context window. Nimbus 2.5 scores 71.2% on SWE-bench Verified and is available in the Nimbus API starting today. Known limitation: "the model can still produce incorrect citations".

item.title: Nimbus 2.5 safety report and system card
item.description: The system card describes red teaming, safeguards and the safety evaluations run on Nimbus 2.5 before release.
